definition.interpretation: The numeric observation instrument reported a consistency score of 0.9, satisfying the threshold but remaining unvalidated due to the lack of an independent oracle.
definition.limitations: Lack of an independent measurement oracle means numerical summary alone does not validate the instrument.
definition.next_step: Refine the experimental protocol with additional granularity levels and stricter controls.

definition.next_experiment: Design a refined numeric observation experiment.
definition.reason: Initial inconclusive measurement requires further refinement and testing.
definition.stop_condition: Stable behavioral consistency across multiple granularities.
definition.uncertainty: Behavioral consistency across scales requires deeper empirical calibration.
